snippet.title: Platypus Reclayed Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Our video game made with clay is finally out! Platypus Reclayed is a fast and frantic arcade-style shoot-em-up.  

💥 OUT NOW on PC, Mac, Xbox, Nintendo Switch and Playstation
🚀 Steam 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2912430/?utm_source=BossShowcaseYoutube 
❗️ Find out more https://claymatic.games/platypus-reclayed
💬 Join our Discord https://discord.com/invite/claymatic

Platypus was a game created 23 years ago by artist Anthony Flack. Working with the Claymatic team (that’s us) we recreated the classic into the present.

Reclaimed. Remade. RECLAYED.

The original game was made from clay, and so is Platypus Reclayed. Reprogramming from scratch and updated with modern hardware, featuring all-new clay models and artwork photographed in 4k widescreen. Buckle up for updated gameplay, new weapons, bosses and content!

#platypus #platypusreclayed
